title: official_notice.issued payload (v1)
description: Wire payload of `official_notice.issued`. Carries `establishes_legal_effect: false` as a LITERAL field, so a subscriber that mistakenly wires this event to a deadline has to override an explicit denial rather than merely omit a check (Framework hard invariant 40). No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
